description: This file defines the StringHelper class which provides various static utility methods for handling strings in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes functions for encoding conversions, character escaping, UTF-8 validation, locale-aware number formatting, and symbol mappings for control characters and SYLK encoding.

classes.name: StringHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string manipulation, encoding conversions, character escaping, locale-aware formatting, and control character mappings within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: buildControlCharacters
methods.description: Builds the array of control characters mapping from escape sequences to actual characters.

methods.name: buildSYLKCharacters
methods.description: Initializes the array mapping SYLK escape sequences to Unicode characters.

methods.name: getIsIconvEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the iconv extension is available and working correctly.

methods.name: buildCharacterSets
methods.description: Ensures that control characters and SYLK characters arrays are initialized.

methods.name: controlCharacterOOXML2PHP
methods.description: Converts OpenXML escaped control characters in a string to PHP control characters.

methods.name: controlCharacterPHP2OOXML
methods.description: Converts PHP control characters in a string to OpenXML escaped sequences.

methods.name: sanitizeUTF8
methods.description: Sanitizes a UTF-8 string by replacing invalid sequences with the Unicode replacement character.

methods.name: returnString
methods.description: A helper method that returns a string value, ensuring correct typing.

methods.name: isUTF8
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number as a string with a dot as decimal separator, regardless of locale.

methods.name: UTF8toBIFF8UnicodeShort
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to BIFF8 Unicode format with uncompressed notation and optional rich text runs.

methods.name: UTF8toBIFF8UnicodeLong
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to BIFF8 Unicode format with uncompressed notation, using 16-bit length.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts a string from one encoding to another, using iconv if available, otherwise mb_convert_encoding.

methods.name: countCharacters
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in a string using mb_strlen.

methods.name: countCharactersDbcs
methods.description: Returns the character count using mb_strwidth.

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: strToUpper
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to uppercase.

methods.name: strToLower
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to lowercase.

methods.name: strToTitle
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to title case.

methods.name: mbIsUpper
methods.description: Checks if a character is uppercase in UTF-8.

methods.name: mbStrSplit
methods.description: Splits a UTF-8 string into an array of individual characters.

methods.name: strCaseReverse
methods.description: Reverses the case of each character in a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: getDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Retrieves the locale-aware decimal separator.

methods.name: setDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Sets the decimal separator explicitly.

methods.name: getThousandsSeparator
methods.description: Retrieves the locale-aware thousands separator.

methods.name: setThousandsSeparator
methods.description: Sets the thousands separator explicitly.

methods.name: getCurrencyCode
methods.description: Retrieves the locale or explicitly set currency code.

methods.name: setCurrencyCode
methods.description: Sets the currency code explicitly.

methods.name: SYLKtoUTF8
methods.description: Converts a SYLK encoded string to UTF-8, replacing escape sequences with Unicode characters.

methods.name: testStringAsNumeric
methods.description: Retrieves the leading numeric part of a string or the string itself if no numeric prefix.
